name: Socialmanager AI Chatbot
author: medusadev

sections.description:
Transform your website with an intelligent AI chatbot that engages visitors 24/7. This plugin provides seamless integration with Social Manager’s advanced conversational AI, helping you:

  • Automate Customer Support – Answer common questions instantly without human intervention
  • Engage Visitors 24/7 – Never miss a lead, even outside business hours
  • Boost Conversions – Guide visitors through their journey with intelligent conversations
  • Reduce Support Costs – Handle unlimited conversations simultaneously
  • Customize Everything – Match your brand with customizable colors and positioning

Key Features

  • Easy Setup – Install in minutes with just a Website ID
  • Smart AI Responses – Powered by advanced language models through Social Manager
  • Beautiful Design – Modern, responsive interface that works on all devices
  • Lightweight – Fast loading with minimal impact on page speed
  • Privacy Focused – GDPR compliant conversation handling
  • Dashboard Analytics – Track conversations in your Social Manager dashboard

How It Works

  1. Sign up for a Social Manager account at socialmanager.ge
  2. Create a website and get your Website ID from the dashboard
  3. Install this plugin and enter your Website ID
  4. Customize the appearance and position
  5. Your AI chatbot is live!

Requirements

  • A Social Manager account (free or paid)
  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Support

For help, visit Social Manager or contact support.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

1. Social Manager (Required)

Social Manager is the AI platform that powers the chatbot. The connection is required for the plugin to work.

  • When the chatbot loads: Your Website ID is sent to Social Manager’s API to retrieve your chatbot configuration.
  • When a visitor sends a message: The message content is sent to Social Manager’s servers for AI processing.

  • Visitor interaction data: Basic interaction data (messages, timestamps) is stored in your Social Manager account.

    https://socialmanager.ge/api/plugins/widget/

  • Service Provider: Social Manager

  • Website: https://socialmanager.ge/
  • Privacy Policy: https://socialmanager.ge/privacy_policy/

By using this plugin, you agree to Social Manager’s Privacy Policy. Please review it before activating the plugin.

2. Google Fonts (Optional, for styling)

The chatbot widget loads the “Inter” font from Google Fonts to ensure consistent typography. This request is made from the visitor’s browser when the chatbot widget renders.

https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter
  • Service Provider: Google LLC
  • Website: https://fonts.google.com/
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

No personal data beyond standard browser request headers (e.g. IP address) is sent to Google Fonts.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to Social Manager’s external API to provide AI chatbot functionality. When users interact with the chatbot:

  • Messages are sent to Social Manager’s servers for AI processing
  • Conversations are stored in your Social Manager account
  • No personal data is collected without user interaction
  • All data transmission is encrypted via HTTPS
  • You can delete conversation data at any time from your Social Manager dashboard

For complete privacy details, please review Social Manager’s Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Socialmanager AI Chatbot”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to Settings > Socialmanager AI Chatbot
  6. Enter your Website ID from Social Manager
  7. Enable the chatbot and save settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Go to Settings > Socialmanager AI Chatbot
  7. Enter your Website ID and configure settings

Getting Your Website ID

  1. Visit socialmanager.ge and log in
  2. Navigate to your dashboard
  3. Create a new website or select an existing one
  4. Copy your Website ID from the settings
  5. Paste it into the WordPress plugin settings
sections.faq:
Do I need a Social Manager account?

Yes, you need a Social Manager account to use this plugin. Visit socialmanager.ge to create one.

Is there a free plan?

Please check Social Manager for current pricing and available plans.

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

Yes! You can fully customize the chatbot directly from the WordPress plugin settings — colors, button style, text, fonts, dimensions, and more. Additional options are available in your Social Manager dashboard.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Absolutely! The chatbot is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices including phones and tablets.

How do I train the AI?

You can configure your AI’s knowledge base and responses through your Social Manager account dashboard.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, Social Manager is designed with GDPR compliance in mind. All conversations are securely stored and can be deleted upon request. Please review Social Manager’s Privacy Policy for complete details.

Can I use a shortcode to place the chatbot?

Yes! Use the shortcode [socialmanager_chatbot] to display the chatbot in specific locations like posts, pages, or widgets.

What languages are supported?

The chatbot supports multiple languages. Configure language settings in your Social Manager dashboard.

How do I view conversations?

All conversations are accessible in your Social Manager dashboard where you can view, search, and manage them.

Can I disable the chatbot temporarily?

Yes, simply uncheck the “Enable Chatbot” option in the plugin settings.

What data does this plugin send externally?

This plugin sends chat messages and your Website ID to Social Manager’s servers for AI processing. See the “External Services” section for complete details.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Full widget customization from WordPress settings
  • Color pickers for primary, secondary, bubble, and background colors
  • Toggle button style options (icon & text, icon only, text only)
  • Custom toggle icon and button text
  • Chat window title, subtitle, and welcome message
  • Header style (gradient or solid)
  • Font family selection (8 options including Google Fonts)
  • Font size selection (small, medium, large)
  • Shadow and animation style options
  • Window dimensions (width, height, border radius)
  • Position offsets and 4-corner positioning
  • Auto-open delay timer
  • Show on mobile toggle
  • Show powered by toggle
  • Tabbed settings page with WordPress color picker integration
  • Local settings override dashboard defaults

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Website ID authentication
  • Customizable widget position (bottom-right, bottom-left)
  • Shortcode support [socialmanager_chatbot]
  • Mobile responsive design
  • Admin settings page
  • Multi-language ready
